claims.text: Integrating graph neural networks with molecular dynamics simulations can accurately predict the mechanical properties of hierarchical-heterostructured HfNbTiVAl10.
The proposed method applies to tensile and fracture testing conditions.
The hierarchical heterostructure is the structural mediator relevant to the prediction.
Machine-learning-based prediction provides the mechanism by which the proposed integration predicts mechanical properties.
The integrated GNN–molecular-dynamics method will improve the accuracy of Young's modulus predictions.
The integrated GNN–molecular-dynamics method will improve the accuracy of yield-strength predictions.
The integrated GNN–molecular-dynamics method will improve the accuracy of toughness predictions.

The integrated GNN–molecular-dynamics method will be more computationally efficient than thermophysical-parameter calculations, CALPHAD, first-principles calculations, and prior machine-learning modeling.
The method's reliability is limited by available computational resources.
The method's reliability is limited by data quality.
The GNN model may not generalize reliably to new, unseen data.
